name: MMLongBench-Doc
intro: MMLongBench-Doc v3 是独立的长上下文多模态文档理解基准。十名作者专家在 135 份长篇 PDF 上复核 425 道来源题并编写 965 道新题，合并 1,176 道候选题后通过三轮半自动质检移除 94 道低文档相关性题，最终得到 1,082 道题：494 道单页、365 道跨页、223 道不可回答。评测先生成自由文本，再由 GPT-4o 抽取短答案并按参考答案格式计算广义准确率和广义 F1。
org: Nanyang Technological University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Peking University, UIUC, NUS, Wuhan University, Singapore Management University, University of Arizona, Fudan University
build_method: 135份长篇PDF, 十名作者专家标注, 三轮半自动质检, 固定1,082题发布
metric: 广义准确率, 广义F1, 按格式的精确匹配/ANLS
modality: 文档, 文本, 图像, 图表, 表格
eval_feature: 长上下文, 跨页推理, 幻觉检测
build_method_en: 135 long PDFs, ten author-experts, three-round semi-automatic QC, fixed 1,082-question release
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Cross-page Reasoning, Hallucination Detection, GPT-4o Answer Extraction
intro_en: MMLongBench-Doc v3 is a stand-alone long-context multimodal document-understanding benchmark. Ten author-experts review 425 source questions and write 965 new questions over 135 long PDFs. After merging 1,176 candidates, three rounds of semi-automatic quality control remove 94 low-document-relevance items and produce 1,082 questions: 494 single-page, 365 cross-page, and 223 unanswerable. Evaluation generates free-form responses, uses GPT-4o to extract short answers, and applies reference-format-specific rules for generalized Accuracy and generalized F1.
metric_en: Generalized Accuracy, Generalized F1, format-specific exact match/ANLS

drawio_review_note: Evidence is pinned to arXiv:2407.01523v3 (PDF SHA-256 82457b6b96f42d2e747297054469352d308b494787313ccb95f7889780d0b882) and official Git/data commit 88b5f09fd29a7638b7c4d82aa6c8f5989ca5c145. The pinned samples.json was verified as 1,082 rows over 135 distinct PDFs with 250 Str, 299 Int, 159 Float, 151 List, and 223 None records. Version identity is explicit: v1 has 130/1,062; v2 has 135/1,091; v3 and samples.json have 135/1,082, even though the README at the same pinned commit still advertises the stale 1,091/33.0%/22.5% figures. Construction preserves 76 existing plus 59 new PDFs, ten author-annotators, 54 batches, 425 reviewed source questions, 211 retained/revised source candidates, 965 new candidates, the 1,176 pre-QC denominator, QC1 removal of 94 items, QC2 13.8% revision rate, QC3 17.5% disagreement with kappa 0.42, and the final 184 source plus 898 new split. Evaluation distinguishes 144-DPI page-image LVLM input from lossy Tesseract OCR+LLM input, records the concise response prompt, GPT-4o extraction prompt (temperature 0, max_tokens 256), marker-split parser, local zero fallback, and uncaught API-runner parse abort. Generalized Accuracy averages scored rows; generalized recall uses 859 answerable rows, precision uses predictions not exactly equal to 'Not answerable', and the group denominators are 494/365/223. The pinned list scorer uses Python eval on list-like predictions; this is faithful to the source but unsafe for untrusted outputs and should be replaced by a literal parser in any hardened reproduction. Repository metadata declares Apache-2.0 code and CC BY-NC 4.0 data/research-only use. This stand-alone 1,082-row release is not the preprocessed 961-row slice used inside MMLongBench. Formal publication evidence [site-a11o-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4965×1529 (English) and 4965×1529 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4963×1527 and 4963×1527. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
